decisions.reason: The cover-text decision does not change the publishing-guidance requirement; its same-message update is independently supported by the request for front and back matter guidance.
The Chapter 12 heading hierarchy and capitalization remain independent of the paperback cover-text decision.
Requiring text on the cover does not change the criteria for assessing chapter illustrations for tone or colour-palette fit.
The cover presentation decision does not necessarily alter the separate publisher attribution on the copyright page.
The decision to include appropriate cover text does not change the chapter-image aspect-ratio or cropping requirements.
Cover text and printed-cover presentation do not modify the manuscript editorial-polish objective or approved prose.
The cover-text decision does not change chapter-image inclusion, chapter placement, integration timing, or the existing cover image count.
Page 2 title-page content is discussed separately, and requiring text on the cover does not necessarily change the title page or its newline-artifact rule.
The same message independently reports tracked manuscript edits, but the cover-text decision does not change which manuscript revision is authoritative.
